extra_trails.name: Fred's Slot
extra_trails.why: Alta trail map (skimap.org 36318): from Mambo down between the Collins lift side and Spring Valley, parallel to Spring Valley; placed by that order and the map's length, then moved onto the open strip in the 1 m canopy height map (Meta/WRI) not taken by another run: tree cover 4% (17% before), moved 18 m on average. Approximate (about 60 m)
